item.title: Diamondbacks outslug Rockies for 5th straight win
item.description: Gabriel Moreno and Nolan Arenado homered in a six-run first inning and the surging Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Colorado Rockies 12-8 on Thursday in Denver to continue their drive for a National League wild-card berth.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Gabriel Moreno and Nolan Arenado homered in a six-run first inning and the surging Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Colorado Rockies 12-8 on Thursday in Denver to continue their drive for a National League wild-card berth. James McCann also went deep for Arizona (85-74), which had a season-high 18 hits in its fifth straight win. The Diamondbacks moved within 2 1/2 games of Philadelphia for the third and final NL playoff berth. The Phillies hosted Milwaukee on Thursday night. Arizona, which holds the tiebreaker over Philadelphia, is assured that at least the first game of its three-game series at San Diego beginning on Friday night will have postseason implications. Geraldo Perdomo, Lars Nootbar and Arenado had three hits each and McCann and Pavin Smith finished with two hits apiece for the D-backs. Cole Carrigg homered among his four hits, Kyle Karros and Zac Veen also homered and had two hits and Connor Norby and TJ Rumfield contributed two hits for Colorado (57-102), which had 17 hits. Arizona sent nine batters to the plate in the first inning against right-hander Tanner Gordon. Moreno's three-run homer started the scoring, Perdomo tripled, Smith singled and Arenado homered to cap the inning. It was Arenado's 29th home run of the season. Arizona scored twice in the second on an RBI double from Ketel Marte and a run-scoring single by Perdomo. Smith had an RBI double in the fourth and scored on McCann's single for a 10-0 advantage. Gordon (1-6) allowed 10 runs on 12 hits in 4 1/3 innings. D-backs starter Eduardo Rodriguez (16-7) allowed two runs on nine hits in six innings. The Rockies broke through against the left-hander when they loaded the bases with no outs in the fourth but managed just one run. McCann hit his sixth home run leading off the sixth inning and Karros homered in the bottom of the frame, his 13th. Hunter Goodman added an RBI single in the seventh and Carrigg hit a three-run shot later in the inning, his 11th of the year, for a 12-6 deficit. Veen hit a solo shot and Rumfield added an RBI double in the eighth. --Field Level Media

item.title: CONSOLIDA Cúpula Trump-Xi em Washington é marcada por grande alarde, mas tem pouca substância
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, recebeu o presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, na Casa Branca nesta quinta-feira para uma luxuosa cúpula de Estado repleta de simbolismo, mas com pouca substância, sem sinais de que uma reunião a portas fechadas tenha gerado avanços em questões espinhosas como inteligência artificial, comércio, Taiwan e a guerra com o Irã.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, David Brunnstrom
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, recebeu o presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, na Casa Branca nesta quinta-feira para uma luxuosa cúpula de Estado repleta de simbolismo, mas com pouca substância, sem sinais de que uma reunião a portas fechadas tenha gerado avanços em questões espinhosas como inteligência artificial, comércio, Taiwan e a guerra com o Irã. Durante uma conversa bilateral à tarde, Xi instou os EUA a se oporem à “independência de Taiwan”, de acordo com um comunicado da agência oficial de notícias chinesa Xinhua logo após o término do encontro. A Casa Branca não divulgou imediatamente seu próprio resumo das conversações. Esperava-se que Xi pressionasse Trump nesta semana para suspender a venda de armas a Taiwan. Após sua visita à China em maio, Trump afirmou que estava suspendendo um pacote de armas para Taiwan no valor de cerca de US$14 bilhões e chamou isso de “um excelente trunfo nas negociações”. Essa medida deixou alguns aliados dos EUA na Ásia e até mesmo alguns pares republicanos de Trump preocupados com a possibilidade de ele se sentir tentado a amenizar o apoio de Washington a Taipé em troca de ganhos econômicos. A China reivindica Taiwan, governada democraticamente, como seu próprio território e não descartou o uso da força para obter o controle sobre a ilha. A cúpula entre os dois líderes ocorreu logo após Trump ter defendido veementemente o uso do poder militar em um discurso na ONU na terça-feira, sugerindo que poderia “aniquilar” o Irã. Ele adotou um tom notavelmente diferente com Xi nesta quinta-feira, refletindo um equilíbrio de poder que se deslocou em favor do líder chinês após uma guerra comercial que terminou com um recuo dos EUA em relação às tarifas. Em declarações após a chegada de Xi nesta quinta-feira, Trump enfatizou sua “amizade verdadeiramente grande” com Xi, em vez de se concentrar nas diferenças políticas, e disse que as duas potências haviam feito avanços no comércio desde sua viagem à China em maio. “Durante esta visita, também discutiremos questões urgentes relacionadas à segurança, tecnologia e ‘superinteligência’”, disse Trump, usando seu nome alternativo para inteligência artificial. Em declarações um pouco mais diretas, Xi afirmou que os interesses dos dois países estavam profundamente entrelaçados e que a competição entre eles deveria ser “saudável”. As empresas norte-americanas eram bem-vindas na China, disse ele, acrescentando que espera que “as empresas chinesas sejam tratadas de forma justa aqui nos Estados Unidos”. Xi também disse que os militares de ambos os países devem manter um diálogo regular para melhorar a prevenção de crises. Edgard Kagan, ex-autoridade da Casa Branca para o Leste Asiático, disse que a retórica contrastante demonstra a estratégia diferente de cada líder. “O presidente está apresentando a questão principalmente como uma questão de seu relacionamento pessoal com Xi”, disse Kagan, que agora trabalha no Centro de Estudos Estratégicos e Internacionais. “O que achei interessante foi que Xi está sendo muito mais cauteloso e sugerindo que se trata menos de um relacionamento pessoal e mais de um relacionamento entre as nações.” A cúpula, que marca a primeira visita de Xi a Washington em mais de uma década, é o segundo encontro deste ano entre os líderes das duas maiores economias do mundo. POMPA E CIRCUNSTÂNCIA Para Trump, que aprecia cerimônias e valoriza seus laços com líderes poderosos, a visita é tanto uma questão de prestígio nacional quanto uma oportunidade para uma diplomacia de alto nível. Mas as declarações de Trump e Xi não foram transmitidas ao vivo por nenhuma rede de televisão dos EUA, que se recusaram a fornecer imagens em protesto contra a proibição imposta pela Casa Branca à CNN, à MS Now e ao Politico. Trump recebeu Xi na chegada na noite de quarta-feira com um tapete vermelho na pista, a primeira vez que um presidente dos EUA recebe um líder estrangeiro na Base Conjunta Andrews desde que o presidente Barack Obama se encontrou com o papa Francisco em 2015, segundo a C-SPAN. Após suas declarações nesta quinta-feira, os dois líderes assistiram a uma cerimônia militar que incluiu uma exibição aérea no Jardim das Rosas. Após a reunião a portas fechadas, Trump levou Xi para conhecer o novo heliporto que havia construído recentemente no gramado sul da Casa Branca. “Ele adora granito de boa qualidade”, disse Trump aos repórteres, acrescentando que os dois tiveram uma “ótima reunião”, sem dar mais detalhes. A aproximação de Trump com Xi pode complicar sua mensagem de campanha nos Estados Unidos antes das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro, quando a estreita maioria republicana no Congresso estará em jogo, enquanto os eleitores se preocupam com a inflação e a guerra contra o Irã. Há meses, o presidente vem rotulando os democratas de “comunistas” em uma tentativa de retratá-los como extremistas, mas recebeu Xi, o líder do Partido Comunista Chinês, como um querido amigo pessoal, com bandeiras chinesas enfeitando o telhado acima do Salão Oval ao lado das bandeiras dos EUA. AVANÇOS POUCO PROVÁVEIS Apesar do alarde, grandes avanços pareciam improváveis, segundo analistas. O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, disse à Fox News na quarta-feira, após conversas com o vice-primeiro-ministro chinês He Lifeng, que eles haviam concordado em prorrogar até 10 de janeiro um acordo que suspende a guerra comercial entre os dois países. Trump escreveu em uma postagem no Truth Social na manhã desta quinta-feira que os dois líderes discutiriam a “superinteligência”, mas mais uma vez demonstrou pouco interesse em novas regulamentações, apesar das preocupações dos líderes do setor de que a IA possa, eventualmente, representar uma ameaça aos seres humanos. “A superinteligência (SI) será um grande tema de discussão, mas quero deixar isso exatamente como está”, escreveu Trump. “Essa também é a posição da China.” Durante seus comentários nesta quinta-feira, Xi disse que ambos os países devem “garantir que o desenvolvimento da IA esteja sempre sob controle humano”. Analistas afirmam que a intensa competição entre as duas potências no campo da IA provavelmente limitará o alcance de qualquer pacto além de acordos simbólicos. MANTER OS LAÇOS ESTÁVEIS Pessoas a par dos planos afirmam que as negociações também poderiam resultar em acordos para reduzir algumas tarifas, combater o tráfico de drogas e ampliar o diálogo entre os militares, enquanto se espera que Trump busque a libertação de norte-americanos e outras pessoas detidas na China. Xi parece estar em uma posição mais forte, tendo supervisionado um aumento no comércio da China e mantendo firme o controle sobre o fornecimento de minerais de terras raras, o que lhe dá uma poderosa vantagem. Ambos os líderes veem vantagens em manter as relações estáveis, com Trump atolado na impopular guerra contra o Irã e Xi enfrentando desafios econômicos internos. Mas, por trás das aparências, há desafios que poderiam reacender as tensões, incluindo disputas sobre Taiwan, controles de exportação, inteligência artificial e a guerra contra o Irã, um aliado da China. Há poucos sinais de que Pequim esteja disposta a exercer pressão sobre o Irã para que ceda às exigências dos EUA. Durante a reunião desta quinta-feira, Xi expressou apoio para que os EUA e o Irã retornem ao cessar-fogo e, eventualmente, negociem um acordo de paz, informou a Xinhua. A lista de convidados para o jantar de Estado desta quinta-feira inclui CEOs como Tim Cook, da Apple; Jeff Bezos, da Amazon; Sundar Pichai, da Alphabet; Sam Altman, da OpenAI; Elon Musk, da Tesla; e Jensen Huang, da Nvidia. Apesar desse leque de nomes, pessoas a par dos planos dos EUA afirmam que Trump provavelmente manterá controles rígidos sobre as exportações de tecnologia norte-americana — controles que Xi deseja que sejam flexibilizados.

item.title: 〔情報ＢＯＸ〕米中首脳会談の主なポイント、貿易休戦の延長合意など
item.description:
Simon Lewis Trevor Hunnicutt David Brunnstrom
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Simon Lewis　Trevor Hunnicutt　David Brunnstrom

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２４日、中国の習近平国家主席をホワイトハウスに迎えた。華やかな国賓訪問の一環として行われた首脳会談では、貿易や人工知能（ＡＩ）、さらには激しさを増す両国の戦略的競争が主要な議題となった。

今回の会談の主なポイントをまとめた。

◎貿易休戦延長は２カ月

ベセント米財務長官によると、両国は会談で１１月に期限を迎える予定だった貿易上の「休戦」を延長することで合意した。ただ延長期間はわずか２カ月にとどまった。

ベセント氏は、この延長によって両国は「経済面で何ができるのかを検討するための時間をさらに確保できる」と説明したが、長期的かつ安定した合意を固めたわけではない。関税、中国による米国製品の購入、レアアース（希土類）の供給、技術関連の規制といった中心的な問題は、次回の交渉へと先送りされた形だ。

ベセント氏は２３日、中国が以前の合意で約束した２５００万トンの大豆購入については義務を果たしている一方、その他の農産物を１７０億ドル購入するという約束については遅れが生じていると述べた。複数の米政府高官の話では、レアアースの供給についても合意した水準に達していない。こうした状況は、両国間に依然として大きな隔たりが残っていることを示している。

企業にとっては、これまで何度も経験してきた不安定な状況が続くことになる。当面、関税率は低い水準に抑えられるものの、企業は引き続き目まぐるしく変化する政策環境を前提に経営判断を下さなければならない。

新たな期限は来年１月１０日。年内に深センとマイアミで２つの多国間首脳会議が予定されている。このためトランプ氏と習氏には、より恒久的な合意に向けて協議を深める機会がさらにあるとみられる。

◎台湾問題で「慎重な対応」要求

習氏は予想されていた通り、台湾問題を取り上げた。中国国営通信の新華社によると、習氏は「米国が台湾問題を慎重に扱い、中米間の戦略的協力と両国関係の発展に向けた強固な基盤を築くことを望む」とトランプ氏に伝えた。また新華社の英語版は、習氏が米国に「台湾独立に反対する」ことを望んだとも報じた。

これは台湾独立を「支持しない」としてきた米国の長年の表現から一歩踏み込んだ要求となる。現時点でトランプ政権が従来の表現を変更する兆候はない。

ホワイトハウスからは、このやり取りについて直ちに公式な説明はなかった。ただ米政府当局者はこれまで、台湾独立に明確に「反対する」との立場を表明することを避けてきた。もし米政府が表現を変更すれば、台湾を防衛する米国の意思に対する疑念が生じるとともに、米議会から強い反発を招く可能性がある。

米国は台湾にとって最も重要な国際的支援国で、米国法に基づき、台湾が自らを防衛するために必要な手段を提供することになっている。もっともトランプ氏は５月に習氏と首脳会談を行った後、最大１４０億ドル相当の台湾向け武器供与計画を「交渉の切り札」と表現し、米国の対台湾関与を巡って疑問が生じた。

◎戦略的リスク

習氏はトランプ氏との会談で、改めて「トゥキディデスの罠」に言及した。これは、台頭する大国と既存の大国との競争は戦争へと向かいやすいとする学術的な理論だ。習氏はそうした危険は「克服できる」と述べたものの、この言葉をあえて持ち出したこと自体が、世界２大国である米中の軍事衝突に対する懸念が、依然として両国関係に暗い影を落としていることを浮き彫りにした。

習氏は、協力すれば米中双方が利益を得られる半面、対立すれば双方が損失を被ると主張。軍同士の定期的な対話を行うとともに、危機を未然に防ぐための仕組みを強化するよう呼びかけた。これに対してトランプ氏は、両国が共有する歴史を引き合いに出し、協力の可能性を強調するとともに、共通の利益を追求すれば両国は多くのことを成し遂げられると述べ、第２次世界大戦で日本を相手に共闘した歴史にも触れた。

◎ＡＩ巡る見解の相違

両首脳はＡＩについて異なる見解を示した。

トランプ氏はＡＩについて、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で「今のままの状態で置いておきたい」と述べ、新たな規制を課すのではなく米司法省に対応を委ねる考えを示した。中国も同じ立場だと主張した。

一方、習氏は２４日、ＡＩを主導する国として米中両国はその発展を管理する必要があると指摘。「われわれには、ＡＩを良い方向に発展させ、管理する能力と責任があり、ＡＩの発展が常に人間の制御下にあり、人々の福祉に資するものとなるようにしなければならない」と述べた。

２４日夜にホワイトハウスで開催される晩餐会には、アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマンＣＥＯ、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯといったＡＩ業界の大物が出席する見通し。

◎演出に注力

トランプ氏にとって、今回の習氏によるホワイトハウス訪問は、自らの構想に沿って姿を変えつつある首都ワシントンを披露する絶好の機会でもあった。習氏は北京でトランプ氏を迎えた際、明代の寺院や、通常は外国人に公開されていない塀に囲まれた庭園を案内したが、今回はトランプ氏がまったく異なる形の華やかな演出でその歓待に応えた。

かつらをかぶり、三角帽子を着用した兵士たちが隊列を組んで行進し、音楽を演奏。舞台となったローズガーデンは、トランプ氏のゴルフクラブを思わせるようなデザインに改装されていた。

２３日と２４日に行われた式典では、戦闘機や爆撃機が轟音を響かせながら上空を飛行した。あまりの音の大きさに、トランプ氏が思わず身をすくめる場面もあった。

トランプ氏は習氏の訪問を前に、ワシントンを美化し、改装するためには、裁判所や米議会から反対を受けたとしても、自らにより大きな権限が必要だと数カ月にわたって訴えてきた。だが、新しいホワイトハウスの宴会場や人工池など、多くの計画はいまだ完成していないか、問題に直面している。

ホワイトハウスの記者団が両首脳の取材に呼ばれた際も、国家の命運に関わる重要な政策について２人が語る場面を取材するためではなかった。代わりに記者団が目にしたのは、両首脳が大統領専用ヘリコプター「マリーン・ワン」を見学し、最近改修されたホワイトハウスのサウスローンを歩いて回る姿だった。そこには、大統領紋章が大きく描かれたヘリポートも設けられていた。

記者から両首脳の政策協議について質問されたトランプ氏は、それを軽くかわした後で習氏について「彼は上質な御影石が大好きなんだ」と語った。

首脳会談に関しては一言だけ「素晴らしい会談だった」と付け加えた。

item.title: Law firms vie for tech talent in AI race
item.description: (Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com)
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: (Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com ) As major companies and startups compete to hire engineers and data scientists to fuel the AI boom, David Wang is hoping to lure technologists to his law firm instead. Cooley, where Wang serves as chief innovation officer, is hiring for more than a dozen high-tech positions amid an escalating AI push at big law firms. The Palo Alto-based firm this month unveiled a new subsidiary it describes as a “firm-owned artificial intelligence company,” Cooley AI, to build internal tools for its lawyers and reshape how it delivers legal services. Wang said Cooley AI will be managed like a startup but integrated with the law firm's decision-making, a mix he said could appeal to AI and other experts who want a job that lets them apply their work directly to legal challenges. "You want people that want to work on really frontier difficult problems, and that is something that is hard for a law firm to promise," he said. The pitch to technical and legal talent is that Cooley AI is the "best of both worlds," Wang said, connecting hires with the law firm's business while offering meaningful work on cutting-edge AI issues. The launch of Cooley AI coincided with the firm's September 17 announcement of a product developed with OpenAI to help companies go public, for use by the firm’s attorneys in client work. It was timed with OpenAI's [USN:L6N45917D TEXT:"release"] of a legal industry-focused version of its latest AI technology, GPT-6 Astra, that it said is designed to help law firms and legal software providers conduct research, draft advice and build custom applications for lawyers. OpenAI said it has also been working with other big law firms on new tools, including Ropes & Gray and Sullivan & Cromwell. Law firms across the board are hiring technologists and strategists to staff AI and technology teams. Covington & Burling; Cravath, Swaine & Moore; Latham & Watkins; Kirkland & Ellis; McGuireWoods; Mayer Brown and White & Case are among those that are currently advertising AI-related job roles on LinkedIn. Salaries range per position, with one firm offering up to $438,000 for a director of applied AI. Cooley, known for its work advising technology and life sciences companies, is currently hiring for 14 roles within Cooley AI, including for senior engineers. At least four hires have already joined, including from other law firms, according to LinkedIn posts. Wang said Cooley AI just hired an engineer from Adobe and that other hires are in the works from large technology companies and startups. He declined to comment on compensation for new hires but said that "the market price is the market price. We're planning to be competitive." The firm's advertised salary ranges on LinkedIn included $220,000 to $250,000 for a senior AI data engineer. That pay would be roughly commensurate to a first-year lawyer's salary at Cooley and other large firms. The race among law firms to incorporate AI has led some firms to publicize their spending on the technology. Kirkland & Ellis in May said it plans to [USN:L6N4251D3 TEXT:"devote $500 million"] of its revenue to developing a custom AI platform over the next three to four years. Personal injury firm Morgan & Morgan has [USN:L6N4560UK TEXT:"committed at least $1 billion"] over the next decade, the firm said this month. Cooley declined to comment about the scale of its investment in Cooley AI. Some law firms, meanwhile, are losing lawyers to AI companies. Forty-six lawyers from the top 200 highest-grossing firms in the United States in the first half of 2026 moved to companies including Harvey, Anthropic and OpenAI, according to a report published on Thursday by legal analytics company Firm Prospects. SEYFARTH SUED AFTER DISCLOSING DATA SECURITY BREACH Law firm Seyfarth Shaw was sued on Thursday by a former employee of one of the law firm's clients who said a recently disclosed cybersecurity incident exposed sensitive personal information belonging to more than 56,000 people. The proposed class action was filed in federal court in Chicago shortly after the firm [USN:L6N45F0WX TEXT:"reported the breach"] to state regulators. The plaintiff is a former employee of AAA Mountain West Group, according to the lawsuit. The Chicago-founded firm did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The firm in a statement this week said the data security incident was isolated to a single employee, and that the firm's security controls prevented access to the firm’s network or systems. 3M ORDERED TO PAY $296,000 TO ILLINOIS' LAWYERS AT DICELLO LEVITT A federal judge in Illinois has ordered 3M to pay nearly $296,000 in legal fees to plaintiffs firm DiCello Levitt, which is representing the state on a contingency basis in a lawsuit alleging contamination from "forever chemicals." US District Judge Sara Darrow in the federal court in Rock Island, Illinois, ruled that the contingency-fee lawyers could recover fees for work related to 3M's unsuccessful effort to move the case from state to federal court. The judge awarded DiCello Levitt $295,933 for about 285 hours of work on the removal dispute. Darrow said courts within the 7th US Circuit Court of Appeals have allowed such awards, even though the appeals court has not directly addressed the issue. Illinois sued 3M in 2022 over alleged contamination of drinking water, soil and air. 3M has denied wrongdoing and has appealed the ruling sending the case back to Illinois state court. The company opposed the state's recovery of fees. 3M and the Illinois attorney general’s office did not immediately respond to requests for comment. On Billable Hour’s radar this week… -- In the era of AI, law firms are placing a greater [USN:L6N45D0YZ TEXT:"emphasis on relationship-building"] as a key competitive advantage, our columnist Sara Randazzo writes. -- Private equity-backed national accounting firm Sorren said it has launched an affiliated law firm, the latest example of [USN:L6N45E109 TEXT:"accounting firms expanding"] into legal services. -- Former star Supreme Court lawyer Tom Goldstein [USN:L6N44K00Z TEXT:"will remain in jail"] while he appeals his conviction in federal court for tax crimes and other fraud. Read More: [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"AI error-ridden court filings surge despite three years of sanctions"] [USN:L6N450049 TEXT:"Legal profession is ‘detrimental’ to mental health, say 41% of lawyers"] [USN:L6N44S168 TEXT:"Rival lawyers clash over fees after $2.8 billion Blue Cross settlement"]

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（24日）＝ドル上昇、利回り上昇 Ｓ＆Ｐ５００横ばい
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一時９月２日以来のドル高／円安水準となる１５８．９８円を付...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（24日）＝ドル上昇、利回り上昇　Ｓ＆Ｐ５００横ばい 7:20 配信

＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一時９月２日以来のドル高／円安水準となる１５８．９８円を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者によるタカ派的な発言を受けて追加利上げ観測が強まったことに加え、堅調な米経済成長への期待を背景に米国債利回りの上昇が続いていることでドル買いが進んでいる。    終盤の取引でドル／円は０．３２％高の１５８．８２円。 片山さつき財務相はこの日、７月の日米協調為替介入を支えた基本原則はなお維持されているとの認識を示したものの、先週の日銀利上げを受けても金融引き締めペースの加速につながるとの見方は広がらず、市場心理は引き続き不安定な状態にある。    日銀は１７─１８日の金融政策決定会合で政策金利を１．２５％に引き上げたものの直後に円安が進み、関係筋によると日銀は１８日、為替介入の準備段階とされる「レートチェック」に踏み切っていた。    米国では企業活動の拡大と物価圧力の高まりを示す経済指標を受け、この日も国債利回りが上昇。３０年債利回りは２００４年６月以来、１０年債利回りは約２０年ぶりの高水準を付けた。この日は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアに対するミサイル攻撃を受け原油価格が再び上昇。インフレ懸念の高まりにつながっている。    ＦＲＢは１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来３年２カ月ぶりで、ＦＯＭＣに合わせて公表された金利・経済見通しでは年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げ実施が示唆された。    ＦＯＭＣ後、複数のＦＲＢ当局者がインフレ鈍化が進まなければ追加利上げの可能性があるとの認識を表明。この日はフィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁がインフレ率をＦＲＢが目標とする２％に戻すには追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見方を示したほか、クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁はインフレ圧力はなお高く、この状況が長引けばインフレ率を目標水準に押し下げることが難しくなると述べた。    ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定する確率は６８．６％。１週間前の５５．４％から上昇した。    ＦＸストリート（ニューヨーク）のシニアアナリスト、ジョセフ・トレビサーニ氏は「２年債利回りは２００８年の金融危機以降のレンジ上限にあり、３０年債利回りは２２年ぶりの高水準、１０年債利回りも１９年ぶりの高水準にある。外為市場参加者にとっては、これ以上の説明は必要ないだろう」とし、「ＦＲＢは今回の原油高は供給ショックによるものと理解しており、その影響をある程度見極めようとしている。ＦＲＢは第３・四半期の経済成長見通しに注目している」と述べた。    終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１５％高の１０１．２８。上昇は４営業日連続で、一時は１０１．３９と、７月２９日以来の高水準を付けた。    ユーロ／ドルは０．０７％安の１．１３７２ドル。一時は１．１３５８ドルに下落し、７月２８日以来の安値を更新した。    ドルはスイスフランに対し０．３４％高の０．８２８スイスフラン。一時は０．８２９６スイスフランに上昇し、２０２５年５月以来の高水準を付けた。スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）はこの日、予想通り政策金利を０％に据え置いた。足元でスイスフランが軟化する中、為替市場への介入は「必要に応じて」行うとし、従来より姿勢を軟化させた。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが上昇し、３０年債利回りは一時２００４年以来の高水準を付けた。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者らが高インフレ抑制に向けた追加利上げの必要性に言及したことが背景にある。    この日は、米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁やニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁が、さらなる利上げが必要となる可能性が高いとの見解を示した。nL6N45G0X6 nL6N45G0MH    ＣＭＥグループのフェドウォッチによると、トレーダーは現在、１０月の次回連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での追加利上げ確率を約７０％と見ている。２３日終盤時点では６６％だった。    ２３日の５年債入札が低調だったことも、利回り上昇に拍車を掛けた。２４日は、７年債入札後も利回りが総じて高い水準を維持した。    コネティカット州ウェストポートに拠点を置くウェルススパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント、オリバー・パーシェ氏は「ＦＲＢが０．２５％、あるいは０．５％の追加利上げを行うことは疑わないが、それでも市場が織り込む水準には追い付いていない」と述べた。    米財務省が、市場の流動性を支えるための継続的な国債買い戻しの一環で、２０・３０年債を４０億７８００万ドル分買い戻したと発表した後、３０年債利回りの上昇幅はわずかに拡大した。このオペでは、１０４億６８００万ドル相当の国債が売り出された。同省は最大６０億ドル相当の国債を買い戻す方針を明らかにしていた。    ３０年債利回りは終盤７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．４７２％。一時５．５０１６％と、２００４年６月以来の高水準を付けた。    指標となる１０年債利回りは７．１ｂｐ上昇の５．１８５％。一時５．２２５１％と、１９年ぶりの高水準を更新した。    ７年債利回りは終盤５．１３３％に上昇した。    ＦＲＢの金利見通しに連動しやすい２年債利回りは１．９ｂｐ上昇の４．９１４％。    景気見通しの指標とされる２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２６．９ｂｐだった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種がほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。中東情勢の不透明感から原油価格と米国債利回りが上昇する中、マイクロソフト が軟調な一方、 メタ・プラットフォームズが値上がりした。    Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合は取引時間中の安値から持ち直した。米国とイランがニューヨークで続けている協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されているとロイターが報じたことが背景にある。    原油市場では北海ブレント先物が３％超上昇。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を受け、供給混乱への懸念が再燃した。    ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのシニア投資ディレクター、ビル・ノーシー氏は「現在われわれが一つの大きな材料に直面しているという見方を強めるものだ」とし、「原油とインフレ、それが金利に与える影響、さらに金利が資本市場全体に与える影響だ 」と述べた。    ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は２４日、インフレリスクを抑制するために、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が年末までに再び利上げを行う必要があるかもしれないと考えるのは「妥当」だと述べた。    Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち８業種が下落し、素材や主要消費財の下げが目立った。    人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の主要銘柄はまちまちで、マイクロソフトが０．５％安、ブロードコムが１．３％安となる一方、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）は２．４％上昇した。    メタは４．５％高。同社は前日、新たなＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」 を利用するための小型端末「メタ・チャーム」を発表した。    オラクルは３．５％下落。ニューメキシコ州のデータセンター開発を手がけるブルー・アウル傘下企業に「不可抗力」を通知したと報じられたことが響いた。ブルー・アウルも下落した。    ＭＧＭリゾーツは１１％急落。富豪のバリー・ディラー氏率いる米メディアのピープルが買収計画を撤回したことが響いた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ ＦＲＢの利上げ観測が強まる中、原油価格の上昇やドル高を背景に下落した。１２月限の清算値は０．５％安の１オンス＝４２９８ドル。現物は１８００ＧＭＴ（米東部時間午後２時）時点で０．５％安の４２６５．５０ドル。一時９月１６日以来の安値を記録した。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は、約３％上昇し１週間ぶりの高値を付けた。フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を受けて供給混乱への懸念が再燃した。    取引は不安定で、米国とイランがホルムズ海峡の再開について協議していると報じられたのを受け、価格は取引時間中の高値から後退した。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．５２ドル（３．４％）高の１バレル＝１０６．６０ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．４５ドル（２．７％）高の９４．６１ドル。取引時間中の高値では、両限月ともに約５％上昇していた。    イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドの「重要目標」と、紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにある国営石油会社サウジアラムコの施設をミサイルと無人機（ドローン）で攻撃したと表明した。    サウジ主導の連合はこの日、フーシ派が２４日に発射した弾道ミサイル６発を迎撃し、南部タイフと紅海沿岸のヤンブー地区への攻撃を阻止したと明らかにしていた。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: China's Jinzhao to begin construction of Peru port in 2027, minister says
item.description: Chinese firm Jinzhao will begin construction of a $405 million port in southern Peru in 2027, Peruvian Transportation Minister Jose Tangherlini said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese firm Jinzhao will begin construction of a $405 million port in southern Peru in 2027, Peruvian Transportation Minister Jose Tangherlini said on Thursday. The project, set to become Peru's third-largest port, will proceed after the government secured a land-transfer deal with Shougang Hierro Peru. Construction is expected to last approximately two years in its first stage, with an initial investment of $200 million, Tangherlini said. Under the agreement, signed with state investment promotion agency Proinversion, Shougang — which held a concession over part of the land — committed to not exercising its mining rights within the project area. The port is part of Jinzhao's broader development plan that includes the Pampa de Pongo iron ore project in southern Peru, with an investment of $1.78 billion. Jinzhao will become the second Chinese company to build and operate a port in Peru, one of the world's largest copper producers. Cosco Shipping Ports' Peruvian subsidiary has operated the Chancay "megaport" in northern Peru since late 2024, which is becoming a hub on the South American Pacific coast.

item.title: Major airline group opposes US diesel export ban, warning it could hike prices
item.description: The head of the group representing major US airlines said carriers oppose a US diesel export ban, saying it could lead to higher prices and have a "drastic impact" on air carriers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The head of the group representing major US airlines said carriers oppose a US diesel export ban, saying it could lead to higher prices and have a "drastic impact" on air carriers. Airlines for America CEO Chris Sununu said the group had spoken with officials at the US Departments of Energy and Interior to express their concerns. "The chain reaction of issues that it causes -- the prices don't go down," Sununu said in an interview of a diesel export ban.

item.title: China Jinzhao comenzaría el próximo año la construcción de un nuevo puerto en Perú: ministro
item.description: La empresa china Jinzaho iniciará en el 2027 la construcción de un puerto de 405 millones de dólares en el sur del país para exportar minerales y otros productos, dijo el jueves el ministro de Transporte y Comunicaciones de Perú, José Tangherlini.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La empresa china Jinzaho iniciará en el 2027 la construcción de un puerto de 405 millones de dólares en el sur del país para exportar minerales y otros productos, dijo el jueves el ministro de Transporte y Comunicaciones de Perú, José Tangherlini. La ejecución del proyecto, que Jinzhao ganó en marzo en una licitación, será posible tras la firma de un convenio entre el Gobierno y la china Shougang Hierro Perú (SHPC1.LM) , que permitirá la entrega del terreno donde se construirá el terminal marítimo, que espera ser el tercer mayor del país, añadió el ministro. Según el convenio firmado con la agencia estatal promotora Proinversión, Shougang -que tenía en concesión de parte del terreno- se comprometió a no ejercer sus derechos mineros dentro del área del proyecto de puerto, agregó Tangherlini. "El próximo año ya estaría iniciando la construcción del mismo y hay un plazo estimado de que dure la construcción de aproximadamente dos años, en su primera etapa", dijo a periodistas el ministro tras la firma del acuerdo. En la primera etapa se invertirá 200 millones de dólares, agregó. El puerto de Jinzhao forma parte de un plan integral de la firma china que tiene el proyecto de hierro Pampa de Pongo, en el sur del país con una inversión de 1.781 millones de dólares. Jinzhao se convertirá en la segunda empresa china que construirá y operará un puerto en Perú, uno de los mayores productores de cobre en el mundo. Actualmente, la filial de la china Cosco Shipping Ports (1199.HK) opera desde fines del 2024 el "megapuerto" Chancay en el norte de Perú, que está convirtiéndose en un hub portuario en el Pacífico sudamericano.

item.title: Anthropic seeks 50.1% voting control for co-founders ahead of IPO, The Information reports
item.description: Anthropic is asking shareholders to approve a new corporate structure that would award CEO Dario Amodei and his six co-founders a combined 50.1% of voting power, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the planning.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic is asking shareholders to approve a new corporate structure that would award CEO Dario Amodei and his six co-founders a combined 50.1% of voting power, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the planning. The new arrangement, which emulates a founder-control structure at Palantir, would award the co-founders a special class of shares giving them collective voting control in most corporate matters, and would apply as long as three of the seven co-founders retain a minimum number of shares in the company, according to the report. Anthropic did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. One significant exception to the founders' control is the election of the members on Anthropic's board, which has seven seats, one of which is currently vacant, according to the report. The company is also planning to give employees a special class of stock that would serve as tie-breaker votes on some corporate issues, the report said. Anthropic, which has been viewed for months as the leader in enterprise AI, is preparing for what could be one of the biggest IPOs on record. The company could push its IPO to after the US midterm elections in November, with the poll not expected to have a major impact on the offering, Reuters [USN:L6N45818P TEXT:"reported"] earlier this month. The Claude maker had [USN:L4N4251V1 TEXT:"raised"] $65 billion at a post-money valuation of $965 billion in May.

item.title: Lula mantém vantagem de 2 pontos sobre Flávio no 2º turno com 47% a 45%, mostra Datafolha
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) manteve vantagem numérica de dois pontos sobre o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) em um eventual segundo turno da eleição presidencial, e os dois candidatos seguem em empate técnico, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) manteve vantagem numérica de dois pontos sobre o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) em um eventual segundo turno da eleição presidencial, e os dois candidatos seguem em empate técnico, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira. Lula tem 47% e Flávio soma 45%. Na semana passada, o placar era de 46% a 44% a favor do petista. A margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais, para cima ou para baixo. Aqueles que declaram voto em branco, nulo ou em nenhum dos dois candidatos diminuíram um ponto, para 7%. Os indecisos seguem registrando 1%. No cenário de primeiro turno, o presidente soma 40%, ante 39% na sondagem anterior, enquanto o senador do PL tem 36%, repetindo o número da semana passada. A distância entre os dois neste cenário, de 4 pontos percentuais, está no limite da margem de erro. Na terceira colocação vem Augusto Cury (Avante), com 5% -- eram 6%, na rodada passada --, seguido de Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), com os mesmos 4% aferidos na última semana. Os demais candidatos não pontuaram acima dos 3%. Aqueles que declaram votos em branco, nulos ou em nenhum dos nomes colocados somam 5%, ante 6% na pesquisa anterior. Os indecisos ficaram em 2%, ante 3% na semana passada. O Datafolha também levantou as intenções de voto em uma resposta espontânea, sem oferecer uma lista com os nomes dos candidatos. Neste cenário, Lula tem 36% (eram 35%), Flávio registra 27% (ante 26%), e o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, pai de Flávio, é citado por 4%. Os demais não superaram o patamar dos 3%. O percentual de indecisos, que era de 21% na semana passada, agora soma 18%, enquanto a fatia do eleitorado que pretende votar em branco, nulo ou em nenhum dos colocados passou de 6% para 5%. A sondagem apontou que 80% dos eleitores estão totalmente decididos sobre o candidato em que vão votar para presidente. Os outros 20% ainda podem mudar seu voto. O instituto também apurou a rejeição aos candidatos, situação em que Lula e Flávio aparecem novamente empatados, com 45% cada. Na rodada anterior, os dois também encontravam-se empatados: 47% dos entrevistados declararam que não votariam de jeito nenhum em Lula ou em Flávio. APROVAÇÃO DO GOVERNO Ainda de acordo com a pesquisa, a aprovação do governo sofreu uma leve variação. Os mesmos 50% que desaprovavam o governo na semana passada foram registrados agora, enquanto a parcela dos que aprovam a gestão oscilou de 48% para 47%. Os que não souberam responder mantiveram-se no patamar de 3%. No quesito avaliação de governo, 40% o consideram "ruim" ou "péssimo" ante 42% na semana passada; 34% o avaliam como "ótimo" ou "bom", mesma fatia verificada na rodada anterior; 24% classificam o governo como "regular" -- eram 23% --, e 2% não souberam responder, percentual que há uma semana marcava 1%. O Datafolha ouviu 2.002 pessoas de 16 anos ou mais entre os dias 22 e 23 de setembro.

item.title: Provincia argentina de San Juan coloca bono internacional por 600 mlns dlrs
item.description: La provincia argentina de San Juan, rica en proyectos mineros, informó el jueves que colocó un bono internacional por 600 millones de dólares con una tasa del cupón del 9,55%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La provincia argentina de San Juan, rica en proyectos mineros, informó el jueves que colocó un bono internacional por 600 millones de dólares con una tasa del cupón del 9,55%. "La provincia tiene un excelente crédito que le valió la posibilidad de acceder al mercado internacional, producto de sus sólidos números fiscales y las buenas perspectivas de su economía impulsada por la minería", señaló el Gobierno de San Juan en el comunicado. La operación del bono, que tuvo una demanda de 1.037 millones de dólares, contó con participación de 67 fondos e inversores.

item.title: The Everything Bubble is back and bigger than ever
item.description: Five years ago, financial speculation was running amok. Then interest rates rose and stocks entered a short-lived bear market. Now the same warnings are flashing again: excess liquidity, high leverage, and exuberant retail investors. The next correction could be more dramatic.
item.dc:creator: Edward Chancellor
item.content:encoded: Five years ago, financial speculation was running amok. This was the heyday of meme stocks, special purpose acquisition companies (SPACs), non-fungible tokens and dubious cryptocurrencies such as Dogecoin. In the summer of 2021 Richard Bernstein, the former Merrill Lynch quantitative strategist turned portfolio manager, put out a note listing five factors which pointed to the existence of a stock market bubble. Within months US equities had peaked and over the following year entered bear market territory. Now the so-called “Everything Bubble” has returned with a vengeance. This time the downside risks appear much greater. Bernstein, who is now global head of macro at the investment firm Janus Henderson, listed increased liquidity as the first bubble factor. Back in 2021, the US money supply was surging after the Federal Reserve’s massive pandemic-induced bond-buying schemes. That excess cash spilled over into the stock market. The US central bank’s balance sheet is no longer exploding. Still, says Bernstein, financial conditions today remain remarkably easy. The Chicago Fed’s index which tracks the metric has trended downwards since late 2022 but remains slightly above its 2021 trough. Increased leverage was a second factor. In 2021 Bernstein pointed out that many retail investors (including 80% of investors who are members of Gen Z) were borrowing to buy stocks. Speculators were also using single stock options to boost returns. There’s even more leverage around today. Margin debt has been growing faster than mortgage and credit card debt, says Bernstein, and now stands at record levels both in dollar terms and relative to GDP. Zero-day to expiry options account for around half of the total turnover of US stock options. Hedge fund leverage is also at an all-time high. In early 2021, the over-leveraged Archegos Capital Management blew up. This summer, Situational Awareness, which had borrowed heavily to buy AI-related stocks, ran into trouble. The hedge fund, run by the former OpenAI employee Leopold Aschenbrenner, managed to avoid Archegos’ fate after Citadel Securities stepped in to acquire the bulk of its publicly listed securities. Other popular sources of speculative borrowing include leveraged single-stock exchange traded funds (ETFs). Defiance ETF, an asset management firm, is even planning to launch ETFs for popular stocks such as software firm Palantir Technologies (PLTR.O) and chip giant Nvidia (NVDA.O) that re-leverage every hour. The Chicago Mercantile Exchange this summer launched single-stock perpetual futures, or “perps”. Great investment bubbles often involve a rapid increase in the number of speculators, enticed into the market by opportunistic financial operators. Bernstein listed the democratisation of the market as a third bubble factor. Back in 2021 Robinhood Markets (HOOD.O) , the app-based broker, was the preferred platform for the crowd which rushed headlong into meme stocks and SPACs they discussed on Reddit’s WallStreetBets message board. Robinhood, whose app bore a passing resemblance to an electronic fruit machine, provided commission-free trading and cheap margin loans. Prior to its July 2021 IPO, Robinhood reported 18 million “funded accounts.” Since then it has added a further 10 million customers. Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev still extols his firm’s democratising mission: “Our product velocity is focused on one goal: making everyone an owner,” he said in July. In this case “product velocity” refers to the extension of Robinhood’s services from trading in shares, fractional shares and cryptocurrencies to making markets in tokenised equities (securities linked both to unlisted private companies such as OpenAI and publicly traded meme stocks like AMC Entertainment (AMC.N) ), and prediction markets. Prediction markets, which allow users to trade coin-flip contracts for a broad array of events, have taken off. Robinhood’s revenue from “event contracts” now [USN:L6N45813E TEXT:"exceeds its crypto business"]. The time-honoured distinction between investment, speculation and outright gambling is collapsing. Kalshi, which partners with Robinhood, recently applied for permission to issue “perps”. As Bernstein observes, “when people confuse the financial markets with the prediction markets something has gone really wrong.” The fourth factor signalling a market bubble is increased new issues. Five years ago, the amount raised by new companies listing on US exchanges reached an all-time high. Tech SPACs - among them Virgin Galactic (SPCE.N) , which offered space tourism, electric truck maker Nikola and battery developer QuantumScape (QS.O) - were all the rage. Nikola has since filed for bankruptcy while the share prices of Virgin Galactic and QuantumScape are down more than 95% from their peak. Today, the IPO market is even hotter. In June, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX.O) – arguably the greatest meme stock in history – raised a record $75 billion. AI leader Anthropic is [USN:L6N45F0XJ TEXT:"preparing a "][USN:L6N45F0XJ TEXT:"listing"] at a mooted $2 trillion valuation. Even SPACs are making a comeback. Bernstein’s fifth and final bubble factor was increased turnover. At the time, US stock market trading volume was running around 25% above its long-term average. This year, equities trading is even more frenetic. In January, the average daily US stock turnover exceeded $1 trillion for the first time. This summer, retail equities turnover was close to twice its average level since the turn of the decade, according to Citadel Securities. Volume on the Nasdaq market is also at record levels. The Everything Bubble proved vulnerable to the end of the zero-interest rate era that arrived in 2022. Today, interest rates and bond yields have returned to more normal levels. In other respects, though, the current bubble looks much more dangerous. The US stock market today is even more concentrated in a handful of giant companies and increasingly exposed to a single theme: AI. Even as OpenAI and Anthropic continue to burn cash, AI investment is driving corporate earnings. Much of the investment is financed with debt. Former Morgan Stanley strategist David Roche points out that total on- and off-balance sheet debt for US tech giants and AI labs exceeds $3 trillion. Circular financing among the leading AI players depends critically on expectations of continuously accelerating revenue growth, so that that even the slightest slowdown risks undermining the whole edifice. Prudent investors should be preparing not for a rerun of the short-lived 2022 bear market but something far more dramatic. Follow @Breakingviews on X

item.title: Lula holds thin lead over Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Brazil election, Datafolha poll shows
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has maintained a two-percentage-point lead over Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, his main challenger, in a potential runoff ahead of October's election, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has maintained a two-percentage-point lead over Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, his main challenger, in a potential runoff ahead of October's election, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday. In a simulated runoff, Lula would receive 47% of the vote compared with 45% for Bolsonaro. A [USN:L1N459120 TEXT:"previous Datafolha poll"] last week had Lula leading Bolsonaro by 46% to 44%. The result also represents a technical tie as it falls within the poll's margin of error of 2 percentage points. In a first-round scenario, Lula leads with 40% of the vote, followed by Bolsonaro (36%), Augusto Cury (5%), Ronaldo Caiado (4%) and Renan Santos (3%). The previous poll showed the leftist president with 39% against the right-wing senator's 36%. Senator Bolsonaro is the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year prison sentence for attempting to overturn his 2022 election defeat to Lula. If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes in the first round, the two frontrunners advance to a runoff. Datafolha surveyed 2,002 people between September 22-23.

item.title: Ares fund withdrawal requests decline as private credit redemptions ease
item.description: Withdrawal requests at Ares Management's flagship private credit fund eased slightly in its third-quarter tender offer, a regulatory filing showed on Thursday, reflecting a broader cooldown in redemptions across the sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Withdrawal requests at Ares Management's (ARES.N) flagship private credit fund eased slightly in its third-quarter tender offer, a regulatory filing showed on Thursday, reflecting a broader cooldown in redemptions across the sector. Investors in the $22.7 billion Ares Strategic Income Fund (ASIF) sought to redeem 13.1% of shares in the third quarter, down from 14.4% in the previous quarter. The fund limited withdrawals to 5% of shares, the customary threshold for such vehicles. Wealthy individuals have pulled money from non-traded private credit funds in recent months amid concerns about lending standards and whether software companies that have borrowed heavily from direct lenders will weather AI disruption. But redemption pressures at major non-traded private credit funds are showing signs of easing as asset managers clear backlogs of withdrawal requests and investor sentiment rebounds from recent turbulence. Earlier this month, [USN:L4N4530XC TEXT:"BlackRock"] (BLK.N) and [USN:L4N45E1DG TEXT:"Apollo"] (APO.N) also reported a decline in redemption requests at their private credit funds. "Redemption demand is easing across most reporting funds, but at several of the largest, requests remain backlogged and persisting. It is too soon to conclude that the broader market has turned a corner, but the direction is encouraging," said Kevin Gannon, chairman and CEO of Stanger, which tracks so-called alternative assets. The Ares fund said much of the redemption pressure came from investors submitting repeat requests, adding that net new withdrawal demands amounted to 3% of net asset value. Major private credit funds have enforced the customary 5% limit on redemptions this year, keeping withdrawal requests elevated as investors resubmit unfulfilled requests in subsequent tender offers. "An investor who first submitted a repurchase request in Q1 2026 and has continued to resubmit any unfulfilled portion of that request in Q2 and Q3 is expected to have received nearly 80% of its originally requested capital," ASIF said. For these investors, the fund expects to mostly satisfy unfulfilled requests by year-end, assuming withdrawal requests remain in line with the third quarter. ASIF Class I shares have generated a 9.97% annualized total return since inception, representing a 161-basis-point premium to broadly syndicated bank loans. Data from Blue Owl (OWL.N) funds is expected in the coming weeks.

item.title: Trump tells countries to quit ICC. Few follow his lead
item.description: President Donald Trump urged countries to leave the International Criminal Court immediately, calling it "evil" and "a rogue institution," but only Naoero, a tiny Pacific island nation formerly known as Nauru, has followed suit during the UN General Assembly this week.
item.dc:creator: Simon Lewis
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump urged countries to leave the International Criminal Court immediately, calling it "evil" and "a rogue institution," but only Naoero, a tiny Pacific island nation formerly known as Nauru, has followed suit during the UN General Assembly this week. Trump's appeal on Tuesday capped an escalating US campaign against the Hague-based court, which Washington says oversteps its authority by claiming jurisdiction over citizens of countries, including the United States and Israel, that have not ratified its founding treaty known as the Rome Statute. While a handful of countries have moved to leave the ICC, many governments, particularly in Europe, have rallied to defend the Netherlands-based court as a cornerstone of international justice. Parties to the statute include 125 countries. Netherlands Prime Minister Rob Jetten, addressing the General Assembly on Thursday, said the court is "under attack" and at risk, without mentioning the United States. "How can you possibly be opposed to prosecuting the very worst crimes?" he asked. "And I believe there can be only one response. To say: hands off the ICC, and all those other institutions that protect the international legal order." The remarks drew loud applause from delegates. The US has imposed financial sanctions and visa bans on court staff, and officials have prepared [USN:FWN45A0PH TEXT:"sanctions"] that could undercut the court's [USN:L6N45D0HW TEXT:"ability to operate"], sources familiar with the matter said. 'DISMANTLE THE ICC' In July, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio launched a diplomatic push to "dismantle the ICC — brick by brick, if necessary," claiming the court posed a threat to American service members and those carrying out Trump's deportations of migrants and strikes on alleged drug trafficking boats. Trump has said the campaign is aimed at protecting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, against whom the ICC issued arrest warrants in 2024 alongside his then-defense minister and a Hamas military commander over the Gaza war. Since Rubio announced the campaign, Venezuela and Chad have announced plans to withdraw from the court. Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger announced their exits the previous year, denouncing the court as an instrument of "neocolonial repression." Naoero President David Adeang said in his speech to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday he would formally withdraw his country from the Rome Statute due to the ICC’s “increasing irrelevance.” "Naoero joins a growing number of nations standing up for their sovereignty against the ICC’s illegitimate overreach,” US Assistant Secretary for East Asian and Pacific Affairs Michael DeSombre said on X after meeting the island nation's deputy foreign minister. DEFENDING THE COURT The European Union rallied behind the court and officials have discussed drawing up a blocking statute in response to the potential US sanctions. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas told reporters this week the bloc had options to defend the court. "We have the tools in our toolbox when it gets really serious, how to defend ICC, and here (at the UN) we are rallying countries behind supporting the ICC functioning and the accountability part because it's not only a European issue; it's much broader than that,” she said. Tomoko Akane, the ICC president already under US sanctions , is a Japanese national. Japan's government called the proposed sanctions "very unfortunate" and dispatched an official to The Hague to discuss how it could support her. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi noted Japan’s support for the ICC in her address to the General Assembly on Tuesday. “Since the end of the Second World War, Japan, as a peace-loving nation, has attached great importance to the rule of law in the settlement of any disputes,” Takaichi said. Brian Finucane, a senior adviser at the International Crisis Group, said many countries remain invested in the ICC's mission of accountability, limiting the impact of Washington's campaign against the court. He noted that Russian President Vladimir Putin targeted the ICC after it issued a warrant for his arrest. “The Trump administration has managed to align itself with Putin in terms of, you know, imposing targeting ICC personnel with sanctions, and of course, Putin would also benefit from the destruction of the court,” Finucane said.

item.title: MGM discusses bid for Barry Diller's People Inc, WSJ reports
item.description: MGM Resorts International is discussing making a bid to purchase Barry Diller's People Inc , the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, a day after People Inc withdrew its proposal to buy MGM Resorts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MGM Resorts International (MGM.N) is discussing making a bid to purchase Barry Diller's People Inc (PPLI.O) , the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, a day after People Inc [USN:L4N45F1IF TEXT:"withdrew"] its proposal to buy MGM Resorts. New York-based People's shares rose 9% after the bell. If it decides to proceed, MGM could make its proposal in the coming days, the report added, citing people familiar with the matter. The move would mark an unusual attempt by MGM Resorts to acquire its longtime largest shareholder, whose approximately 27% stake is valued at nearly the same amount as the media company's own market capitalization, the WSJ report said. Diller began building a stake in MGM in 2020, when the casino operator's shares were battered by closures and travel restrictions due to the COVID-19 pandemic. People, formerly IAC, is a digital media and holding company that owns brands including People, Food & Wine, Southern Living and the Daily Beast. The company has spent recent years streamlining its portfolio around its core publishing operations and its investment in MGM Resorts, where it built a sizeable stake after Diller identified the casino operator as undervalued and as an opportunity to diversify beyond media. Last month, People's second-quarter results pointed to improving profitability at its publishing business, despite pressure on web traffic from AI-driven changes in search, though investors remained largely focused on the value of its MGM stake. MGM did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. People declined to comment.

item.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong joins 40/40 club as Cubs clinch wild-card spot
item.description: Pete Crow-Armstrong became the seventh player in MLB history with a 40-40 season, as he stole his 40th base of the season Thursday, the same day his Chicago Cubs clinched a playoff berth.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pete Crow-Armstrong became the seventh player in MLB history with a 40-40 season, as he stole his 40th base of the season Thursday, the same day his Chicago Cubs clinched a playoff berth. Crow-Armstrong, who is tied for the MLB lead with 45 home runs, joins Jose Canseco (1988), Barry Bonds (1996), Alex Rodriguez (1998), Alfonso Soriano (2006), Ronald Acuna Jr. (2023) and Shohei Ohtani (2024) as the only players to collect at least 40 homers and 40 steals in a season. The favorite for National League Most Valuable Player walked to lead off the first inning against the visiting Miami Marlins and promptly stole second base. He was stranded at third that inning, but the Cubs (88-71) went on to beat the Marlins 2-1 to lock in their NL wild-card playoff spot with three games to go. Crow-Armstrong, 24, has played in all 159 games for the Cubs this season and batted .280 with 107 RBIs. His 45 long balls are tied with Philadelphia's Kyle Schwarber for the major league lead. --Field Level Media

item.title: Police arrest actors, politicians protesting against Netanyahu outside UN
item.description: Police arrested at least 30 people including actors and politicians as they protested outside United Nations headquarters on Thursday against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of his speech at the General Assembly.
item.dc:creator: Maria Tsvetkova
item.content:encoded: Police arrested at least 30 people including actors and politicians as they protested outside United Nations headquarters on Thursday against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of his speech at the General Assembly. Oscar-winning actor Susan Sarandon, Emmy winner Hannah Einbinder, Democratic congressional candidate Darializa Avila Chevalier and New York City council member Chi Osse were among those arrested. “What’s being done to Gaza, the obliteration of an entire society, in our name, with our tax dollars, this is our responsibility to speak out against, and Netanyahu has no right to use the platform of the United Nations to justify these atrocities,” said Manijeh Moradian, a 50-year-old university professor of Iranian and Jewish heritage, who took part in the protest. At the General Assembly, Netanyahu [USN:L1N45G05J TEXT:"defended Israel's actions"] in the region, seeking to counter growing international isolation ahead of elections he could lose, as dozens of delegates streamed out of the General Assembly Hall. The rally was organized by Jewish Voice for Peace, a Jewish activist group that supports Palestinians. Around 200 people gathered outside the United Nations in identical white T-shirts with printed slogans "Fund people not bombs," "No war" and "Free Palestine." The group blocked traffic, and police ordered them to leave through loudspeakers. Some people moved to the sidewalks, but the core group of protesters remained seated on the pavement and continued chanting anti-Netanyahu slogans as police officers, who arrived on bicycles, surrounded them. One by one officers pulled protesters from the group, tied their hands behind their backs with zip ties and escorted them to police buses. The activists kept chanting "Netanyahu go to hell" outside the buses.

item.title: Índice de pobreza põe Milei à prova na Argentina antes das eleições
item.description: Sopas comunitárias lotadas, o ressurgimento de clubes de troca e famílias que recorrem a empréstimos de curto prazo para comprar mantimentos estão evidenciando tensões sociais crescentes na Argentina, enquanto economistas esperam que dados oficiais divulgados nesta quinta-feira mostrem o primeiro aumento da pobreza desde que o presidente Javier Milei controlou a inflação.
item.dc:creator: Nicolás Misculin
item.content:encoded: Sopas comunitárias lotadas, o ressurgimento de clubes de troca e famílias que recorrem a empréstimos de curto prazo para comprar mantimentos estão evidenciando tensões sociais crescentes na Argentina, enquanto economistas esperam que dados oficiais divulgados nesta quinta-feira mostrem o primeiro aumento da pobreza desde que o presidente Javier Milei controlou a inflação. O Instituto Nacional de Estatística e Censos (Indec) da Argentina informou que a pobreza atingiu 32,3% da população no primeiro semestre de 2026, ante 28,2% registrados no período anterior. As estimativas da Universidade Católica da Argentina (UCA) são consideradas um indicador antecipado das tendências oficiais de pobreza. Elas sugerem que a taxa pode subir para 35% da população até o final do ano, revertendo parte de uma queda acentuada que reduziu a taxa para 28% em 2025 e marcando um revés para Milei pouco mais de um ano antes da próxima eleição presidencial na Argentina. “A cada trimestre, nos últimos quatro trimestres, entre 400 mil e 450 mil pessoas caíram na pobreza”, disse Agustín Salvia, diretor do Observatório Argentino da Dívida Social da UCA, que previu que a taxa de pobreza se situa atualmente entre 31% e 32%. Se confirmado, o aumento ainda deixaria a pobreza bem abaixo dos níveis observados durante o primeiro ano de mandato de Milei. Analistas afirmam que isso poderia indicar que os avanços sociais impulsionados pela desaceleração da inflação estão perdendo força, com novos progressos cada vez mais dependentes de uma criação de empregos mais robusta e do crescimento dos salários reais. “Um aumento modesto da pobreza não anularia a grande redução observada sob o governo de Milei, mas sugeriria que a parte mais fácil da melhora já chegou ao fim”, afirmou Nicholas Watson, diretor-gerente para a América Latina da consultoria Teneo. TENSÕES ECONÔMICAS TESTAM APOIO Milei chegou ao poder no final de 2023 com forte apoio de eleitores de baixa e média renda, indignados com anos de inflação galopante. Embora seu governo libertário tenha desacelerado drasticamente a alta dos preços e estabilizado as finanças públicas, organizações sociais e profissionais de assistência social afirmam que mais argentinos estão tendo dificuldades para pagar as contas. Em um salão comunitário nos arredores de Buenos Aires, Ana Barreto ajuda a administrar um clube de troca, onde moradores trocam mercadorias em vez de usar dinheiro. “A pobreza se agravou drasticamente”, disse Barreto, uma professora que fundou o clube em agosto em Villa Astolfi, revivendo uma prática associada a crises econômicas do passado. Óleo de cozinha, açúcar, farinha e macarrão estão entre os itens mais procurados, disse ela, frequentemente trocados por roupas usadas e utensílios domésticos. As dificuldades crescentes parecem estar prejudicando o apoio entre os eleitores de baixa renda, à medida que Milei avança rumo a uma provável candidatura à reeleição em 2027. As últimas pesquisas de opinião mostram que o índice de aprovação de Milei caiu drasticamente entre os entrevistados mais pobres, levantando dúvidas sobre se ele conseguirá manter uma base eleitoral que foi fundamental para sua vitória na eleição anterior. Uma pesquisa da AtlasIntel realizada em setembro revelou que a desaprovação entre os entrevistados de baixa renda — definidos como aqueles que ganham até cerca de US$650 por mês — subiu para quase 70%, enquanto a aprovação caiu para menos de 30%. Um ano antes, os números eram de 57% e 37%, respectivamente. Em nível nacional, 58% desaprovam Milei, enquanto 38,1% o aprovam. INFLAÇÃO MAIS BAIXA NÃO É MAIS SUFICIENTE Cortes nos salários do setor público, a eliminação de subsídios para transporte e serviços públicos e a flexibilização das regras de importação pressionaram as famílias e oneraram alguns setores com foco no mercado interno. O governo de Milei afirma que as medidas de austeridade são necessárias para restaurar a estabilidade econômica, eliminando os déficits orçamentários crônicos que contribuíram para repetidas crises econômicas e alta inflação. Argumenta que equilibrar o orçamento e gerar um superávit fiscal fortalecerá as finanças públicas, tranquilizará os investidores e criará as condições para um crescimento sustentável. Mas Gustavo Raúl Pérez, dono de uma loja de ferragens em San Fernando, ao norte de Buenos Aires, disse que seu negócio foi prejudicado porque os clientes não têm mais condições de comprar. “Quatro anos atrás, eu tinha filas de clientes. Eu vendia dez carrinhos de mão; agora vendo apenas um”, disse Pérez. “Votei em Milei acreditando que ele traria mudanças para melhor, mas ele realmente me decepcionou”, acrescentou Pérez. O desemprego subiu para 7,9% no segundo trimestre deste ano, ante 7,6% no mesmo período de 2025. O emprego no setor privado vem caindo há 13 meses consecutivos e a recuperação da renda das famílias estagnou em grande parte, disse Watson. O governo afirma que manterá o rumo. “O presidente não vai se desviar nem um milímetro de seu programa. Ele não vai flexibilizar sua política monetária (contracionista) para ganhar eleições”, disse um porta-voz do governo à Reuters. O governo de Milei se recusou a aumentar os gastos públicos ou renovar subsídios — medidas frequentemente utilizadas em anos eleitorais —, argumentando que isso comprometeria seus esforços para conter a inflação e manter a disciplina fiscal. Em outro clube de troca criado há dois anos, Melany Malén Borré disse que muitos se sentem frustrados porque as melhorias em seus padrões de vida não se concretizaram. “Acho que as pessoas que votaram em Milei esperavam um progresso que nunca aconteceu”, disse Borré. (Reportagem de Nicolás Misculin, reportagem adicional de Miguel Lo Bianco)

item.title: Lula deve anunciar veto total às bets e linha de crédito para clubes de futebol, dizem fontes
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva deve apresentar na sexta-feira uma medida provisória para proibir totalmente as apostas online no país e, ao mesmo tempo, oferecer uma linha de crédito com juros mais baixos aos clubes de futebol para minimizar o impacto da perda de patrocínio, disseram fontes do governo que acompanham as discussões sobre tema.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva deve apresentar na sexta-feira uma medida provisória para proibir totalmente as apostas online no país e, ao mesmo tempo, oferecer uma linha de crédito com juros mais baixos aos clubes de futebol para minimizar o impacto da perda de patrocínio, disseram fontes do governo que acompanham as discussões sobre tema. De acordo com as fontes ouvidas pela Reuters, a decisão ainda não está 100% tomada porque estão sendo analisadas as bases técnicas e jurídicas para a medida, que iria além de uma ideia inicial de banir apenas os chamados cassinos online. O veto total foi um pedido de Lula à equipe, afirmaram as fontes. Na semana passada, como mostrou a Reuters, a tendência do governo era proibir apenas os cassinos -- que representam cerca de 70% da arrecadação dos sites de apostas -- e restringir a propaganda dessas empresas. No entanto, a avaliação do presidente, que é candidato à reeleição, foi de que a proibição total faria mais sentido para a população. Uma pesquisa Atlas/Bloomberg divulgada esta semana apontou que 71% dos entrevistados "concordam totalmente" com a proibição das bets, e apenas 13% "discordam totalmente." Ao mesmo tempo, o levantamento apontou que 36% dos entrevistados avaliam que a disseminação das bets foi causada pelo governo Lula, enquanto 25% consideram que foi pelo governo Jair Bolsonaro. Na verdade, a liberação das apostas esportivas no Brasil aconteceu em 2018, ainda no governo de Michel Temer. FINANCIAMENTO PARA OS CLUBES Em meio às notícias sobre as discussões no governo a respeito das restrições às bets, houve uma forte reação contrária dos clubes de futebol. Na semana passada, os principais clubes do país divulgaram uma nota contra a intenção do governo, alegando que a retirada do recurso de patrocínios -- cerca de R$1 bilhão por ano -- iria "acabar com o futebol". Apesar de uma reação forte nas redes sociais contra os clubes, o governo reconhece que pode haver um impacto inicial pela proibição das bets até que os patrocínios se reacomodem. Por esse motivo, o governo irá criar uma linha de crédito com juros mais baixos, em uma tentativa de diminuir um pouco a resistência. Lula planeja fazer o anúncio das duas medidas na sexta-feira, em São Paulo. Ao mesmo tempo, deve ser anunciada uma nova medida do governo para combater o endividamento da população -- o terceiro programa do governo para tentar reduzir as dívidas. O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, disse na semana passada, em entrevista ao jornal Extra, que a proposta consiste na compra com deságios altos de dívidas não pagas de pessoas físicas que os bancos ou empresas já tenham considerado, ou estejam perto de considerar, como perdas.

item.title: Microsoft President Brad Smith to lead communications department
item.description: Microsoft President Brad Smith will oversee the company's communications department, a company spokesperson confirmed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Microsoft President Brad Smith will oversee the company's communications department, a company spokesperson confirmed on Thursday. The change puts Smith, one of Microsoft's most prominent public-facing executives, in charge of corporate communications as the company faces issues ranging from artificial intelligence to regulation. Smith has become a prominent voice for Microsoft on public policy issues, including AI governance, technology regulation and the geopolitical implications of the company's global expansion. Brent Colburn, vice president for global public affairs, will serve as interim communications leader during the transition, the spokesperson said. Smith joined Microsoft in 1993, and in 2002 he was named Microsoft's general counsel, a role in which he spent the next decade leading the company's efforts to resolve antitrust disputes with governments around the world and companies across the technology sector.

item.title: Rangers improve playoff hopes with win over Mets
item.description: Kumar Rocker pitched five solid innings on Thursday afternoon for the Texas Rangers, who salvaged the finale of a three-game series and boosted their playoff hopes with a 3-1 victory over the New York Mets in Arlington, Texas.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kumar Rocker pitched five solid innings on Thursday afternoon for the Texas Rangers, who salvaged the finale of a three-game series and boosted their playoff hopes with a 3-1 victory over the New York Mets in Arlington, Texas. Josh Jung hit the go-ahead, two-run homer in the first and Corey Seager went deep in the fourth for the Rangers (79-80), who opened the day tied with the Houston Astros for first place in the American League West. The Astros were scheduled to open a season-ending, four-game series against the Athletics later Thursday in West Sacramento, Calif. Houston won the season series over the Rangers 9-4, meaning Texas must take the division outright. Jung finished 3-for-3 and raised his season average to .299. Carson Benge had an RBI double in the first inning for the Mets (73-86), who entered Thursday two games behind the Washington Nationals to sit in last place in the National League East. The teams are scheduled to play in the final series of the season this weekend in Washington. New York hasn't finished in last place since 2003. Rocker (6-11) allowed one run on three hits and two walks while striking out four in his first start against the Mets, who drafted but did not sign him in 2021 due to concerns over his arm. Robert Garcia, Tyler Alexander and Chase Silseth combined for three innings of one-hit ball before Jordan Montgomery recorded his first save of the season and the second of his nine-year career with a perfect ninth. Montgomery recorded his first save on Sept, 11, 2024, when he tossed the final three innings for the Arizona Diamondbacks in their 14-4 win over the Rangers. Zac Thornton (5-6) took the hard-luck loss for the Mets after allowing two runs on four hits and one walk while striking out four over five innings. The left-hander finished his rookie season with a 3.42 ERA in 15 starts. Four players had a hit apiece for the Mets -- including Brett Baty, whose single in the seventh inning extended his on-base streak to 17 straight games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Airbus identifies A321neo quality defect but says no safety risk
item.description: Airbus said on Thursday it had identified and contained a "quality issue" in the fuselage structure of its A321neo aircraft, but that planes could continue operating because it did not pose a safety risk.
item.dc:creator: Allison Lampert, Carlos Méndez, Mrinmay Dey
item.content:encoded: Airbus (AIR.PA) said on Thursday it had identified and contained a "quality issue" in the fuselage structure of its A321neo aircraft, but that planes could continue operating because it did not pose a safety risk. The defect affects about 500 aircraft, including roughly 250 already in service and 250 in production, according to a source familiar with the matter. The A321neo, Airbus' largest and most popular single-aisle jet, seats up to 244 passengers and is designed to fly routes of up to 4,000 nautical miles (7,400 km). The defect does not impact the planemaker's longer-range A321XLR, said the source, who could not speak publicly about the private matter. It is the second industrial problem to affect the fuselage of the industry's best-selling model in nine months after Airbus [USN:L8N3X902K TEXT:"reported"] defects with fuselage panels last December. Airbus also described that issue as a quality problem with no safety implications, but unravelling the situation caused several months of delivery delays. Airbus said it had discovered what it described as a "deviation" in the surface protection, or coating, applied to skeletal components known as stringers that run lengthways in a fuselage. It said the discovery was made while parts were already undergoing rework on the production line. Airbus has identified and contained the source of the issue and a remedy is available, it added. The latest snag comes as Airbus is trying to increase production of narrow-body jets to 75 a month from about 60 now. The source said Airbus first spotted the problem over the summer and the first results from closer analysis came back recently. This part of the plane is made by Airbus' in-house aerostructures unit Stelia, which was not immediately available for comment outside of business hours. Customers are continuing to take aircraft deliveries without insisting on extra work being carried out in advance and Airbus has told customers there is no immediate requirement to repair, the source said. European regulators may, however, issue a directive requiring the defects to be repaired within a certain period. US carrier Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) , which operates A321neo planes, said it was continually in contact with manufacturers and would "always take action to meet or exceed operator recommendations and regulator directives." Industry publication the Air Current first reported the issue on Thursday.

item.title: Soja recua em Chicago enquanto mercado acompanha encontro entre Trump e Xi
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) registraram queda nesta quinta-feira, enquanto os operadores aguardavam para ver se a visita do presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, à Casa Branca impulsionaria a demanda da China por produtos dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) registraram queda nesta quinta-feira, enquanto os operadores aguardavam para ver se a visita do presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, à Casa Branca impulsionaria a demanda da China por produtos dos EUA. O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, recebeu Xi na Casa Branca para uma cúpula de Estado pomposa, que se espera que seja rica em simbolismo, mas pobre em conteúdo. Alguns operadores do mercado de grãos estavam ficando impacientes com a falta de notícias concretas sobre acordos comerciais resultantes da cúpula. O secretário do Treasury dos EUA, Scott Bessent, disse à Fox News na quarta-feira, após conversas com o vice-primeiro-ministro chinês He Lifeng, que eles haviam concordado em prorrogar até 10 de janeiro um acordo que suspendeu uma guerra comercial em que as tarifas mútuas chegaram a ultrapassar 100%. Exportadores privados relataram vendas de 120.000 toneladas métricas de soja dos EUA para a China, informou o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA (USDA) em seu sistema de relatórios diários. O contrato de soja novembro da CBOT fechou em queda de 0,50 centavo, a US$13,17-1/2 por bushel. O milho fechou em baixa de 1,50 centavo, a US$5,2750 por bushel, também sob influência das expectativas em torno do encontro de Xi com Trump. Os contratos futuros de trigo caíram para a mínima em quatro semanas nesta quinta-feira, devido às crescentes esperanças de uma recuperação nas exportações de grãos da região do Mar Negro, segundo analistas. Os renovados esforços diplomáticos para pôr fim à guerra na Ucrânia mantiveram a atenção dos operadores voltada para as perspectivas dos embarques do Mar Negro. O contrato de trigo dezembro na CBOT fechou em queda de 1,50 centavo, a US$7,07 por bushel. (Reportagem de Tom Polansek)

item.title: Yankees place RHP Clarke Schmidt (biceps) on IL
item.description: The New York Yankees placed right-hander Clarke Schmidt on the 15-day injured list with right biceps neuritis Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Yankees placed right-hander Clarke Schmidt on the 15-day injured list with right biceps neuritis Thursday. The move is retroactive to Monday. The club recalled right-hander Bradley Hanner from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre in a corresponding move. Schmidt had his second Tommy John surgery in the summer of 2025 and was not activated until earlier this month. In his one and only appearance, he gave up two hits and struck out two in two-thirds of an inning Sept. 16 during a 5-4, 13-inning loss to the Minnesota Twins. Now, he will be shelved until at least Oct. 6, ruling him out for the American League wild-card round. Schmidt, 30, was a starter for the Yankees from 2023-25 but worked in relief before that. In 98 career games (67 starts), he is 23-24 with two saves, a 3.81 ERA, 139 walks and 386 strikeouts across 394 innings. Hanner, 27, made his major league debut on Aug. 14 and played four games, pitching to an 11.81 ERA (seven earned runs in 5 1/3 innings) without a decision. --Field Level Media

item.title: Açúcar bruto recua na bolsa ICE, café arábica volta a se aproximar da mínima de 3 meses
item.description: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE se estabilizaram nesta quinta-feira, após atingirem uma máxima de uma semana no início do dia, enquanto o café arábica voltou a se aproximar de uma mínima de três meses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE se estabilizaram nesta quinta-feira, após atingirem uma máxima de uma semana no início do dia, enquanto o café arábica voltou a se aproximar de uma mínima de três meses. AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,17 centavo, ou 1%, a 17,58 centavos por libra-peso, após ter atingido 18,02 centavos/libra-peso no início do pregão. * A produção de açúcar na região centro-sul do Brasil, principal área produtora, deve ter caído 42,5% na primeira quinzena de setembro, depois que as chuvas atrapalharam a colheita, de acordo com uma pesquisa com dez analistas publicada pela equipe da S&P Global na noite de quarta-feira. * "Estamos vendo mais atrasos na moagem relacionados às chuvas (no Brasil) e há previsão de mais chuvas na primeira semana de outubro. O mercado ainda pode testar os 18,60", disse o corretor e consultor independente Michael McDougall. * Ele também observou que o aumento dos preços do petróleo está impulsionando a alta do açúcar, mas acrescentou que a demanda continua fraca. * A Índia, por exemplo, está se aproximando de novas regulamentações para restringir a venda de alimentos gordurosos e açucarados em um raio de 50 metros das escolas, a mais recente proposta para reduzir o consumo de "junk food" no país. * O preço do açúcar branco subiu 0,8%, para US$509,90 por tonelada métrica. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 0,55 centavo, ou 0,2%, a US$2,7535 por libra-peso, voltando-se para a mínima de três meses registrada na terça-feira, de US$2,6300. * A safra de café de 2026 do Brasil, maior produtor mundial, deve totalizar um recorde de 67,6 milhões de sacas de 60 kg, informou a agência nacional Conab, elevando sua estimativa anterior de 66,7 milhões, já que as produtividades mais altas do arábica mais do que compensaram a menor produção de robusta. * "Persiste a incerteza sobre o que um super El Niño poderia significar para o enchimento dos grãos no Brasil e sobre as condições de seca que ele normalmente traz para a Indonésia", afirmou a Cardiff Coffee Trading em uma nota, acrescentando que as condições permanecem satisfatórias por enquanto. * O contrato de futuro do café robusta caiu 0,8%, para US$3.290 por tonelada, após atingir na terça-feira a menor cotação em três meses e meio, de US$3.218. * "A oferta robusta do Brasil e o aumento constante das exportações do Vietnã estão pressionando os preços do robusta", disse um trader baseado no Vietnã, principal produtor de robusta. CACAU * O cacau em Londres fechou com alta de £55, ou 1,3%, a £4.183 por tonelada. * Gana, segundo maior produtor de cacau, dará início à sua safra de 2026/27 na sexta-feira e anunciará o preço na origem para a safra, segundo informaram cinco fontes à Reuters. * A corretora ADMIS informou que as chuvas devem continuar nos próximos dez dias na África Ocidental, principal região produtora, aliviando as preocupações com a safra 2026/27. * O contrato futuro de cacau de Nova York subiu 1,1%, para US$5.590 por tonelada. (Reportagem de May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: 'Name is... Juice': Juszczyk appeals fine over alleged beer-drinking celebration
item.description: San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk has filed an appeal against a fine he received from the NFL this week, after the league said he had imitated swigging a beer during an on-field celebration.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
